ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with high-intensity (white) punctate regions, exhibiting a ratio of approximately 1:12 white-to-black pixels on the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark gray/black base layer with high-contrast white circular and ring-shaped pixel clusters distributed non-uniformly across the distal and medial sections of both visible lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Micro-serrations and irregular pixel-step variations are visible along the distal margins of both lobes, particularly prominent at the tips which show a jagged, non-linear boundary against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral upward convex sweep; the left lobe displays a wider-angle trajectory compared to the more vertical orientation of the right lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial detection of high-contrast white circular pixel groups, varying in diameter from 3 to 10 pixels, consistent with calcified scar tissue.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular depigmentation and pockmarking across the visible integument of both lobes, resulting from historical ectoparasite attachment.
